name: UVD Robot
def: Mobile ultraviolet disinfection robot that drives itself around hospital rooms and exposes surfaces to short wavelength light after manual cleaning.
body: The UVD Robot is a wheeled base carrying a vertical array of ultraviolet C lamps that damage the genetic material of pathogens on exposed surfaces. Lidar, three 3D cameras and passive infrared sensors let it drive a recorded route through wards and operating theatres, and shut the lamps off if a person is detected. It was developed with Odense University Hospital in Denmark and shipped in large numbers during the 2020 pandemic response, mostly to hospitals, airports and offices.
facts: Developed with Odense University Hospital in Denmark
Shipped in large numbers during the 2020 pandemic response
A third generation Model C followed in 2020
specs: Differential drive base carrying a vertical array of ultraviolet C lamps
Lidar, three 3D cameras and passive infrared motion sensors
Map based route recording with autonomous, semi manual and static modes
